body: Main is green and pushed. STATE 10:10Z. Tonight was ONE defect class: a measurement we could not make, published as a measurement we made; sign-agnostic, so it flatters on some metrics and penalises on others. FIXED ON MAIN: SignatureProjection substituting 0.0 for five absent components in the flagship scalar score; coherence emitting PERFECT for an empty flow; fidelity's 0.5 cliff (only 2 of 4 fixture units cleared it, so the published figure was a mean over two units standing in for four); route:transition-direction comparing per-level ranks as a global axis (RETIRED, not silently corrected); Unranked typed Ineligible instead of Missing(ProviderAbstained); interview publishing observed(0.0) - the worst specificity there is - for units OUR pipeline failed to classify or locate; unplaced mass counted as the participant's external detail in internalRatio. SECOND CLASS, mostly open: a private constructor on a case class is NOT a boundary - 84 such classes, 80 with public fromProduct, 45 guarding real validation. Refinements the chief got wrong first and corrected: copy is suppressed only by BARE private, not by private[x] (25 of 79 across ten modules still emit copy, and copy is the worse door because it is idiomatic); one hiding type DOES exist (CheckedSidecarPrelude exposes private[codec] blockDigests via a public _2). THREE of four documented promises are currently false - Coverage (the support carrier 8 modules rely on), Credence (= design-contract rule 3), CheckedSidecarPrelude. The FOURTH, AuthorizedRemoteRequest's raw-text guarantee, HOLDS - an earlier chief claim that it was false was WRONG; its payload type PseudonymizedText is unforgeable AND unobtainable, and it is the positive pattern to copy. Its policy envelope still fails. CRITERION: a promise survives a forge only if some field's type is both unforgeable and not otherwise obtainable. Ten AGENTS.md rules added tonight, most because someone got it wrong first. ACTORS: m1 active (importance coverage blocked on a golden re-cut, authorized with independent chief re-derivation); scout active (route measurement); ENGINEER SILENT 58min holding embed-core - not reassigned, rule 5 threshold is 2h. OWNER: PD checklist written, awaiting acceptance; STORYATLAS4S STILL HAS NO GIT REMOTE.
